title: C3 · Signed attestation (B -> C)
description: Request body of HTTPS POST /v1/attestations, sent by miner-core once per closed epoch (retried from an offline queue). See contracts-schema/README.md for how evidence_hash and signature are computed.

start.description: Epoch start, Unix ms. Must equal epoch * epoch_length_ms.

plants.description: Plant states for the epoch. Every tag_id must belong to this miner's registered sticker set.

frame_hashes.description: sha256 of the frames used this epoch (from C1). Included so the validator can recompute evidence_hash.

flags.description: Device-side anti-cheat flags raised this epoch (informational for the validator and admin portal).

amount.description: Claimed AIR for the epoch in base units (18 decimals). This exact value is signed and minted.

calibration_hash.description: keccak256 of the canonical species-catalogue JSON used for the estimate (PRD 8.1 #5).

signature.description: Device-key secp256k1 signature over the mint digest (README: Signing).
